newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis values flat, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis values flat, trade quiet.

text.p: The majority of rail and truck soymeal offers were unchanged Monday in very quiet trade, U.S. soymeal brokers said.
Most dealers were now quoting basis offers over CBOT July futures before expiration of the May contract on Tuesday. Dealers said there were few trades seen at the new values.
"It's absolutely dead around here," said one dealer in Illinois.
Despite Monday's quiet cash markets, domestic demand for soymeal was said to remain quite sound and supportive to near-term prices, soymeal brokers said.
"The livestock numbers are still pretty good right now, but once the the warmer weather comes, demand should trail off," a dealer in the southeast said.
